name: insightsocial
description: Public data from Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, X/Twitter, Threads, YouTube, Reddit and Pinterest through one API: profiles, posts, comments, followers, search, ads and transcripts as clean JSON. One key, one credit balance, priced per call, failed calls free.
